import json,math,struct
H=lambda x:struct.unpack('<e',struct.pack('<e',x))[0]
mu=H(H(math.sqrt(H(.3)))**2);a=4*mu;tr=1/(3.5*a)
out=[]
for c in d:
 maxima={'position':0.,'speed':0.,'orientationDegrees':0.}
 for row in c['rows']:
  t=row['tick']/120
  if c['kind']=='Supported':p=[0,.25,0];v=[0,0,0];theta=0
  elif c['kind']=='Settle':
   toi=math.sqrt(.375)
   p=[0,1-2*t*t if t<toi else .25,0];v=[0,-4*t if t<toi else 0,0];theta=0
  else:
   x=t-.5*a*t*t if t<tr else tr-.5*a*tr*tr+(5/7)*(t-tr)
   vx=1-a*t if t<tr else 5/7
   theta=-5*a*t*t if t<tr else -5*a*tr*tr-(20/7)*(t-tr)
   p=[x,.25,0];v=[vx,0,0]
  q=[0,0,math.sin(theta/2),math.cos(theta/2)]
  pe=math.sqrt(sum((x-y)**2 for x,y in zip(row['p'],p)));ve=math.sqrt(sum((x-y)**2 for x,y in zip(row['v'],v)))
  norm=math.sqrt(sum(x*x for x in row['rotation']));dot=abs(sum(x*y for x,y in zip(row['rotation'],q))/norm)
  ae=math.degrees(2*math.acos(min(1,dot)))
  maxima['position']=max(maxima['position'],pe);maxima['speed']=max(maxima['speed'],ve);maxima['orientationDegrees']=max(maxima['orientationDegrees'],ae)
 bound={'position':.025,'speed':.1 if c['kind']=='Friction' else math.sqrt(6)*.1,'orientationDegrees':5}
 out.append({'kind':c['kind'],'maxima':maxima,'bounds':bound,'verdict':'Pass' if all(maxima[k]<=bound[k] for k in maxima) else 'Fail','final':c['rows'][-1]})
print(json.dumps({'referenceFriction':mu,'rollingTime':tr,'checks':out}))
